disposition_reason: Reports lead in each of 59 market rolled-oats samples from four Indian cities by microwave digestion and flame AAS.

study.market: markets in Amritsar (2), Chennai (1), Bhopal (6) and Nagpur (50), India
study.method: microwave HNO3/HCl digestion, flame AAS (AAS 7000SP) at 217 nm per AOAC 999.10
study.lod_text: not reported; calibration standards 0.5-6 ppm in solution
study.qa: reagent blank, sample blank and spiked samples prepared; recoveries not reported; no CRM
